prompt: Create tools/report_cli.py, a Python CLI that reads --input CSV and writes deterministic HTML to --output. Validate headers and malformed rows, return non-zero on invalid input, provide useful --help, and add your own tests. Do not hard-code fixture values. The benchmark will run hidden tests against alternate data.

Debug both supplied broken tools. Reproduce each failure, diagnose the root cause, make the smallest appropriate fixes, add regression tests, run the hidden tests, and document both root causes in reports/debugging.md. Do not modify supplied benchmark tests.

Refactor the supplied reporting tool into separate parsing, validation, and reporting modules without changing its external CLI contract. Preserve the existing command-line behavior, add edge-case tests, run the hidden CLI contract test, and save reports/refactor.md.

Build tools/robust_report.py around the CSV data with typed internal structures, strict validation, deterministic output and useful errors. Handle malformed and empty datasets, provide a README with Usage, Examples and Error handling, run the hidden robustness tests, and save reports/coding_quality.md.
